_doc: memory-mesh bridge: one memory, every model. Sources feed recall; lanes decide which data classes a model may see; targets wire a harness to the memory. A host-local ~/.config/memory-mesh/bridge.json deep-merges over this file (same keys). See BRIDGE.md.

mesh._doc: The fleet memory corpus: only what the fold publishes as servable.

vault-fleet._doc: Example markdown source, off by default. Turn on per host in the local bridge.json.

external-example._doc: Example command source, off by default. Any program that speaks the JSON protocol in BRIDGE.md can be a source.

lanes._doc: allow = data classes this lane may receive. 'unknown' means the class could not be decided (for example the client-terms file is missing).
lanes._max_chars: Static-context budget per lane in characters (default 3500, about 900 tokens). Recall reaches everything else.

claude-session._doc: Claude Code outside a fold-generated folder: SessionStart hook injects this render.

gemini._doc: Antigravity and Gemini read this as global rules.

opencode._doc: The opencode plugin reads the local-lane render when the session's provider is local (Ollama).

opencode-cloud._doc: ...and this strict render for any other provider.

mcp-opencode._doc: Strict lane: one stdio server cannot see which provider an opencode session uses, so the tool door assumes cloud. Local sessions still get the local render through the plugin.

mcp-corral._doc: Every Corral pane on every lane gets this server through Corral's own MCP proxy.
